phase: Copy & Content Overhaul — Product-Focused Supply Chain Messaging
target: Remove freight-forwarder, port, inspection, and lab focus across all touchpoints; replace with product flexibility, multi-commodity supply chain management, and buyer outcomes.

stories.title: Hit list and Copy Change Log
stories.description: Exhaustive repository scan for all forbidden terms and variants. Generate comprehensive Copy Change Log with current text, proposed replacement, rationale, and statutory flags.
acceptanceCriteria: Step 0 search completed across client, server, seeds, AI prompts, and docs
Copy Change Log documented in detail with before/after text and reasons
Statutory and legal lines clearly flagged as KEEP
Zero unhandled or missed public touchpoints

stories.title: Banner, header, footer and home copy
stories.description: Update top scrolling banner, header utility bar, home hero, capability cards, sourcing guarantees, sample request CTA, and footer directory.
acceptanceCriteria: Top banner replaces port/FCL strings with multi-commodity supply chain capabilities
Home copy emphasizes direct growing regions, flexible forms, and 48-hour quotation
Footer sample links updated from 'Lab Samples' to commercial product samples
Surat registered office preserved on footer statutory lines; marketing mentions removed

stories.title: Export Process and About Us copy
stories.description: Rewrite Export Process 8 steps into buyer-outcome language without port/agency names. Refine About Us guarantees to focus on specification matching and delivery.
acceptanceCriteria: Export Process 8 steps reflect buyer outcomes (specification, packing, documentation, delivery)
Zero inspection agency names (SGS, Intertek, Bureau Veritas) or Indian port names in process steps
Shipping documents checklist provides neutral 'Export Documentation on Request'
About Us guarantees replace 'Lab reports' with specification and batch documentation

stories.title: Product page badges, rows and seeds (hide empty fields)
stories.description: Update Product Detail page: replace 'Primary Loading Port' and lab/inspection rows with product-focused rows (forms, packing options, direct sourcing). Ensure empty fields remain cleanly hidden.
acceptanceCriteria: Product PDP quick metadata matrix shows Forms Available instead of Port of Loading
Container transit panel replaced with 'Export Sourcing & Supply Chain' panel
Empty/unverified specs remain completely hidden on public site
Soybean Meal and product seed notes updated to eliminate fumigation/lab claims

stories.title: FAQ, SEO and meta, sitemap text
stories.description: Align FAQ categories and questions/answers with product flexibility and agreed-per-order port policy. Update client/index.html title/meta and JSON-LD schema.
acceptanceCriteria: FAQ answers replace port names and third-party inspection with agreed-per-order and specification matching
FAQ group 'Compliance & COA' renamed to 'Regulatory & Compliance Documentation'
client/index.html title updated from 'Export B2B' to 'JHS GLOBAL — Indian Multi-Commodity Supply Chain Exporter'
JsonLd schema reflects 4 divisions and complete supply chain description

stories.title: AI prompts, fact ledger and re-indexed embeddings
stories.description: Update AI system prompts, fact ledger, mock responses, and re-index vector database to strictly promote product flexibility and agreed-per-order port logistics.
acceptanceCriteria: AI prompts updated to refuse medical claims, ports naming, and third-party lab claims
Company facts seed updated (sourcing, quality control, agreed port of loading)
Embeddings re-indexed across all products, FAQs, and company facts
AI test battery confirms buyer-outcome responses and routes open questions to staff

stories.title: Admin placeholders, dropdowns and docs
stories.description: Clean admin desk placeholders, inquiry summaries, and documentation to reflect product-focused supply chain standards.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin desk inputs and placeholders reflect supply chain and flexible processing terms
Documentation files (agent.md, database-design.md, system-design.md) updated
No internal developer placeholders or TODOs exposed to the public

stories.title: Full verification and report
stories.description: Run lint, client vitest, server vitest, production build, automated copy audit, Playwright visual screenshots, and generate final verification delivery report.
acceptanceCriteria: npm run lint passes with 0 errors
npm test and npm run test:client pass with 100% success
npm run build completes with zero errors
Automated copy search confirms zero forbidden terms across public site
Playwright desktop and mobile screenshots captured across key pages
